title: Box the Trait
goal: Store heterogenous types inside a vector using owned trait objects.
hints: `dyn Render` has an unknown size at compile time, so slice elements must wrap it in indirection.
The items vector expects owned trait objects wrapped in `Box`.
explanation: `dyn Render` is a dynamically sized type. It cannot be placed directly into a slice without indirection. Plain `Render` is rejected because traits are not concrete types. Wrapping the trait object in `Box` gives it a fixed size. Each element passed into the vector must be constructed with `Box::new(Text(...))`.
